results.title: ITAR Requirements Made Simple for Contractors - CMMC Compliance
results.snippet: What is ITAR and who does it apply to? ITAR applies to organizations that manufacture, export, broker, or provide services related to defense articles and technical data listed on the United States Munitions List.

results.title: ITAR Registration: A Critical Step for Defense Contractors
results.snippet: Legal Requirement Companies involved in defense manufacturing or services must register with ITAR to operate legally. Non-compliance can lead to severe penalties, including fines of up to $1 million per violation and criminal charges.

results.title: Understanding ITAR Compliance: What Metal Stamping Companies Should Know
results.snippet: Even if you're a small machine shop producing a single bracket for a defense contractor, if that bracket is designed for a defense article on the USML, you likely need to register. Importantly, you need to register before you begin manufacturing ITAR-controlled items or handling technical data related to them.
